missedEssential.fact: The contract file ade-run-errors.json records the AdeTaskService.Run result for the no-claude case, where the Claude Code CLI is missing.
When the Claude Code CLI is not found, the run note says "could not start: Claude Code CLI not found. Install it, then retry."
In the no-claude case the outcome has result "failed", status "failed" and route "stop".
P257 removes per-file and per-commit added/removed line counts in the git module from the UI because the user found them noisy and useless.
A git 2.43 probe on a conflicted working tree showed `git diff --name-status -M -C HEAD` and `--numstat` list the same path set.

`packages/git-ui/src/components/FileTree.vue` has 4 count render sites: tree-mode and flat-mode directory rows (`N files +x -y`, aggregated in `fileTreeModel.ts`) and tree-mode and flat-mode file rows (`+a -d`, hidden when `isBinary`).
`AdeChangesTab.vue` `fileDelta()` renders `binary` or `+a −d` per branch file in the ADE Changes tab, fed by `RangeFiles` via `ade/board_facts.go toWireFiles`.
The diff view decides binary at diff time from the diff itself (`porcelain.BodyBinary`, git-core `model/diff.ts` `kind: 'binary'`), covered by flow subtest `binary diff is not text`.
D1 rejected keeping a numstat spawn only for binary because it pays a full content diff for an unused flag.
D1 rejected `git diff --raw` because it gives modes/oids, not binaryness, and `check-attr` because it sees only attributes, not content.
The numstat record shape (digit-tab / empty-path rename header) lets `collectNumstatRecs` distinguish a header from a path record by position, handling files named `stash@{0}` or a 40-hex name (F14).
Moving the stash list to `--name-status`/`--name-only` was rejected because it would require re-deriving the parser for no visible gain, with one spawn per list either way.
Contract fixtures `tests/contract/git-commit-detail.json`, `ade-base.json` and `ade-review-open.json` are regenerated via `KIRA_CONTRACT=write`, and only the removed keys may change.
Only the `git-graph-detail-visual-linux.png` visual baseline is re-recorded; the other four git-module visual snapshots must pass unchanged because the stash dialog has no file tree.

missedEssential.fact: ChunkMarkdown takes source text and a Budget and returns chunks and a document title.

ChunkMarkdown returns the first-level heading text as the document title.
ChunkMarkdown recognizes setext headings (underlined with = or -), and a setext level-1 heading supplies the title.
When a markdown document has no first-level heading, ChunkMarkdown returns an empty title.
